description: The help window's permissions: Tauri's core set (events, window) and core:window:allow-start-dragging, which the title strip needs to move the window (Tauri's default set grants the double-click zoom but not the drag), and nothing else. The dialog plugin is driven from Rust only (Save report) and none of its commands is granted to the page, so the page cannot open or write a file by itself.
